item: Write the project goal in one sentence
notes: Done when: someone outside the project can read it and explain it back.

item: List what is included and what is not
notes: Done when: the list is written down and the team has read it.

item: Name one person who makes the final call
notes: Done when: everyone knows who to ask when opinions differ.

item: Get the budget approved
notes: Done when: the amount is confirmed in writing (an email is fine).

item: Share the project brief with the team
notes: Done when: every team member has replied to say they have read it.

item: Talk to five future users
notes: Done when: you have notes from each conversation saved in one place.

item: Agree the look and feel
notes: Done when: colors; fonts and a few example screens are approved.

item: Test the prototype with three people
notes: Done when: you have a list of what confused them.

item: Get final design sign-off
notes: Done when: the decision-maker has approved in writing.

item: Set up tools and shared folders
notes: Done when: everyone on the team can open and save work.

item: Back up your work somewhere safe
notes: Done when: you have restored one file from the backup to prove it works.

item: Keep a running list of known problems
notes: Done when: each problem has an owner and a priority.

item: Check it works on a phone and a computer
notes: Done when: you have tried the main steps on both.

item: Write one clear sentence about what it does
notes: Done when: a stranger understands it in under ten seconds.

item: Prepare the announcement text and images
notes: Done when: the decision-maker has approved the wording.

item: Send a preview to early users
notes: Done when: at least five people have tried it and replied.

item: Walk through the whole checklist one last time
notes: Done when: every earlier item is ticked or has a written reason it is not.

item: Agree who is on call on launch day
notes: Done when: names and phone numbers are shared with the team.

item: Announce it
notes: Done when: the message has gone to everyone on your list.

item: Hold a short review afterwards
notes: Done when: three things to keep and three things to change are written down.
